papers.title: Learning vision-driven reactive soccer skills for humanoid robots

papers.title: Physical AI is enabled by mechanical hardware

papers.title: Evolution of humanoid locomotion control
papers.reason: 人形机器人运动控制的技术演进综述，梳理双足与类人运动控制的发展脉络。属综述类文献，重要但不紧急，与 VLA 操作研究无直接复用点。

papers.title: Robot Finger Feels in Color
papers.abstract_snippet: Imagine running your fingertip over the surface of a U.S. penny. Getting a robot to sense the same things is an imposing task, often requiring gathering data on pressure and force at many spatial locations at once.
